daily_cost.scope: New calls in this authorization only. Earlier unresolved reservations remain in their original closed ledgers. Abandoned protocol-development calls are included. Local compute and human time are unpriced.

original_costs.scope: Explicit original-study subtotal, including transport costs. Later review stages excluded; unsettled reservations retained separately. This is not the present all-experiment grand total.

expansion_details.scope: Source-size/attempt columns and the displayed prespecified sensitivity aggregates, reconstructed from packages, records and saved hidden observations.

heldout_usage.scope: Adopted response tokens and reported costs, including reasoning. Unknown transport reservations remain in separate ledgers and are not treated as zero-priced completed outputs.

primary_costs_and_sequence.scope: List-16 cost/tokens cover all attempted records, not only complete groups. Original Web-Bench costs include historical transport calls; sequential score stops at two consecutive current-file failures and is not the same-page full-history endpoint. No writable Ledger or new execution.

table_details.scope: Read-only appendix-source reconstruction. Does not launch browsers, resume generation, modify ledgers, or compare every LaTeX cell.

pilot_tables.scope: Historical pilot table counts from per-case saved evaluations and candidate records; round-1 generation fees from read-only ledger/request identities. Identical first/final pages reuse reports; absent executable outputs remain failures. No browser rerun or modification of frozen source, linker or main ledger. Surrounding prose and every token/timing claim are not all reconstructed here.

name_and_body.scope: Accuracy/denominator and rejection columns from candidate records plus retained hidden scores, keeping original transport exclusions. Reference-choice agreement, all per-condition costs and adequacy-search prose are outside this check; no browser reexecution.

interface_controls.scope: Original current-task fixed controls, distinct from the new full-history endpoint. Reconstructed from raw Playwright reports, without fresh browser execution or recompilation.

format_relaxations.scope: Strict live backups and relaxed saved observations; Qwen Duo verdicts also reconciled with raw Jest reports. Not a new compiler or browser/Jest run; original posthoc status retained.

finite_schema.scope: All semantic configurations of this one frozen finite schema, including optional-field omission. Official init includes layout and basic calculations and is necessary for full history. Zero success is an executable bounded audit, not a formal proof, a current-task impossibility result or a statement about the other five libraries. Same source is scored once; all raw failures retained.

container_network_probe.scope: Blank data URL only, no external navigation, no benchmark scoring. navigator.onLine is an environment hint, not proof of Internet connectivity.

scope: Independent recomputation from retained raw reports, source records, deterministic control proposals and read-only ledgers; no fresh API or browser execution.
